ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited has announced an open market share buyback program of up to INR 697 million, with a maximum buyback price of INR 500 per equity share. This initiative, opening August 14, 2026, aims to efficiently utilize surplus cash, enhance shareholder value by improving financial ratios like EPS and ROE, and offer shareholders a flexible exit option. A key takeaway is the substantial premium offered (approximately 58% over recent market closing prices around INR 324), indicating a strong commitment to the perceived intrinsic value of the shares and potentially signaling management's confidence.
